sources.title: Centroid M-Series Operator's Manual, CNC12 (Oak/Allin1DC mill), chapters 11-13

program_open.value: No start code required in the text; optional O<number> program number line (O9100-O9999 is special: extracted into a subprogram file, not run). % marks not mentioned.

program_close.value: End with M30: by default M30 does nothing and is meant to be customised (Intercon posts it). M2 is NOT a plain end: it moves Z home, then restarts the program from the first line and waits for Cycle Start.

comment.value: ';' to end of line (internal comment). ':' as first character = visible comment line shown on screen. Parentheses are NOT comments: () and [] are numerical-expression delimiters.
comment.note: A post that emits (comment) will be misread; use ';'.

line_numbers.value: Optional N block numbers, used as GOTO targets and search; no maximum stated.

block_end.value: One block per line (examples); no other block-end character described.
block_end.note: Explicit statement not found; inferred from examples only - treat as weak.

safe_start.value: Codes exist: G90/G91 (12.38), G17 (12.7), G20/G21 (12.8/12.9, program units only, native units unchanged), G40 (12.14), G49 (12.15), G80 (12.27), G94 = cancel inverse time (12.42). No prescribed safe-start line; manual's own examples start 'N1 G90 G17 M25'.

tool_change.value: T<n> M6 (T selects, M6 executes; T alone does nothing). D word for diameter offsets.

tool_change_behaviour.value: M6 always moves Z to home first (even if customised by mfunc6.mac), stops spindle and coolant; with ATC (parameter 6 = 1) the PLC changes the tool; otherwise it waits for Cycle Start (manual change). M6 can be replaced by a macro file c:\cncm\mfunc6.mac.

tool_length_comp.value: H<n> selects the offset (modal, can be on its own line), G43 applies (+), G44 (-), G49 or G43 H00 cancels. Not automatic with T.

spindle.value: S<rpm> (does not start spindle); M3 CW, M4 CCW, M5 stop.

work_offset.value: G54..G59 (or E1..E6) = WCS 1-6; optional extra-cost 12 more: G54 P1..P12 (WCS 7-18) or E7..E18.
work_offset.note: Note G54 P, not G54.1 P.

arc_format.value: G2/G3 with R (positive small arc, negative big arc; not for full circles) or I J K incremental from start; absolute I J K only if parameter 2 bit 0 is set. G18 direction note: G2 appears CCW in XZ.

rapid_linear.value: G0 / G1. G0 is a dog-leg: Z up first then XY when Z rises; XY first then Z when Z falls.

feed.value: F in units per minute (inch or mm); default 3.0.

decimal_point.value: Examples treat integers as whole units (G01 X2 Y3 moves to X2, Y3). But G83 Q is subject to 'implied floating point' rules of parameters 245/246, which v4.12 does not explain: write every value with a decimal point.
decimal_point.note: Implied-decimal behaviour UNKNOWN; do not rely on integers.

retract_home.value: M25 = Z to Z home (Return #1 Z) at max rate; G28 = to reference point via intermediate point (G28 G91 Z0 = Z straight home), Z moves first when going up; G53 X~ Y~ Z~ = one-shot rapid in machine coords (G90 only, L word sets rate).

coolant.value: M7 mist, M8 flood, M9 off. No through-spindle code.

dwell.value: G4 P<seconds> (0.01..327.67 s); X used if P absent; default 0.01 s.

drill_G81.value: G81 X Y Z R (F modal, K repeats).

dwell_drill_G82.value: G82 X Y Z R P (P seconds).

peck_G83.value: G83 X Y Z R Q ; Q peck; rapid out to R each peck, rapid back to clearance set by G10 P83 R<clear> (parameter 83).
peck_G83.note: The 2-line format there also lists L as dwell, apparently lathe-derived.

chipbreak_G73.value: G73 X Y Z R Q F ; retract per peck set with G10 P73 R<amount> (parameter 73).

rigid_tap_G84.value: G84 X Y Z R (P dwell s) ; spindle CW must be started first. Floating: F (units/min) with S sets the lead implicitly. Rigid tapping (if enabled): Q = thread lead/pitch, not modal, must be on every hole line.

bore_G85.value: G85 X Y Z R ; feed in, feed out.

return_level.value: G98 initial point (default); G99 R point.

cycle_cancel.value: G80 (G0-G3 also cancel). Cycles need X and/or Y to execute; repeats use K, not L.

cycle_dwell_units.value: Seconds, same as G04 (G74, G82, G84, G89).

native_language.value: Fanuc-like G-code with Centroid macro extensions (IF/GOTO, [] expressions, M-function macros, Intercon conversational front end that posts G-code). No mode switch.

notes: Latest v5.40+ mill manual could not be fetched (406 to curl, >10 MB for WebFetch); values are from v4.12 (2018) and may have changed. Big differences: parentheses are expressions not comments; M2 restarts the program; M30 is a no-op custom code; repeats use K; extended WCS is G54 P1-12.
